releaseNotes: New: BinTV Live, a new source of live games (NBA and football) with commentator streams. New: StreamEast 2 game pages for NBA, NFL, NHL, college and more. Improved: The Pirate Bay results now fall back to its site pages when its search service is down. Sports and live TV sources now switch to a backup address when one stops answering (DaddyLive, CDN Live, AnimeTosho).
